stage.description: How mature an applicant team or project must be. Where a program restricts by maturity — idea, prototype, live product, revenue — that restriction goes here rather than into the description prose.

geography.description: Where applicants must be based or where the funded work must happen. The residency/location axis, distinct from the legal axis in 'jurisdiction'.

jurisdiction.description: Legal and sanctions constraints on who may receive funds — the compliance-driven half of location. Kept separate from 'geography' because a globally open program can still exclude sanctioned jurisdictions.

sector.description: The problem domain or vertical an applicant must work in, where that is an eligibility gate rather than a preference. Topical interest that is not a gate belongs in categories/tags.

entityType.description: What kind of legal entity may apply — individual, unincorporated team, company, non-profit, DAO. Frequently the first thing that disqualifies an applicant and frequently buried in prose.

compliance.description: Process obligations an applicant must accept to be eligible: KYC/KYB, audited financials, reporting commitments, agreement terms.
